# Mamma & Mia Cakes And Catering

## About
Mamma & Mia Cakes And Catering is a family-owned bakery in North West, South Africa, founded in 2012 by Lety Gibbon. We specialize in custom celebration cakes, artisan cupcakes, and dessert catering for events across the region. Every cake is hand-decorated using family recipes passed down from Lety's Italian grandmother, with fresh ingredients sourced from local North West farms.

## Services
- **Custom Celebration Cakes** — Birthday, wedding, and anniversary cakes designed to your vision. Flavors range from classic vanilla to our signature North West honeycomb. From R450.
- **Cupcakes & Treats by the Dozen** — Fresh daily cupcakes with custom frosting and toppings. Perfect for office parties, school events, and gifts. From R180 per dozen.
- **Event Catering** — Dessert tables and pastry platters for weddings, corporate events, and parties across North West. Full setup included. Custom quotes available.

## Location
North West, South Africa
Service areas: Klerksdorp, Potchefstroom, Stilfontein, Rustenburg
